name: Guangdong Silver Age Sci & Tech Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Silver Age Sci & Tech Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of polymer materials in China. The company's principal products include PC, PP, ABS, PC/ABS alloy, PA, PBT, PET, PPS, PVC/ABS alloy, packaging materials, flame retardant resins, reinforced toughening resins, plastic alloys, functional masterbatches, and other categories as well as recyclable, new energy, consumer electronics and 5G, 3D printing, electronic chemicals, smart lighting, medical, degradable, automobiles and smart home materials.
